title: ARI-RQGM erasure state ({ckpt}/rqgm_erasure_state.json)
description: Derived, rebuildable rollup of every SelectiveErasureEvent / FrontierRebuildEvent in rqgm_audit.jsonl (see docs/reference/rqgm_schemas.md, section 'Frontier-repair schemas (Task 10)'). Staleness is logical-only: readers derive a record's stale flag as record_id ∈ stale_record_ids — no stored JSONL line is ever rewritten. Absence of the file means nothing stale, all valid. Rewrite-snapshot with indent=2, ensure_ascii=False (ari.checkpoint.save_erasure_state_json).
